home-page.tagline: Architecting low-latency systems and scalable infrastructure.

paragraphs.hello: Hello there! I am a FullStack Engineer focused on building execution-critical systems and low-latency backend infrastructure.
paragraphs.craft: My engineering experience is heavily centered around speed, reliability, and capital-aware architecture. I specialize in designing highly concurrent systems where milliseconds, distributed state, and risk decisions directly impact real-world outcomes.
paragraphs.learn: Whether it is engineering a WebSocket-first orderbook pipeline, developing fault-tolerant microservices, or ensuring state recovery in under a second, I love tackling complex backend challenges and building tools that handle live, volatile data.
